ctx: 영화 「All the Old Knives」(2022, 아마존 프라임 비디오 오리지널, 한국 제목 「배신의 만찬」, 감독 Janus Metz, 원작·각본 Olen Steinhauer). Chris Pine as Henry Pelham, a CIA case officer at the Vienna station; Thandiwe Newton as Celia Harrison, his former colleague and lover, now retired, married with children in Carmel, California; Laurence Fishburne as Vick Wallinger, the Vienna station chief; Jonathan Pryce as Bill Compton, Henry's mentor (retired, in London). Story: in 2012 terrorists hijack Royal Air flight 127 at Vienna airport; all 120 passengers die; eight years later evidence suggests a mole in the Vienna station leaked information; Vick sends Henry to interview Bill and then Celia; Henry and Celia meet for dinner at a seaside restaurant in Carmel and relive what happened; flashbacks show their affair, Celia's sudden departure; the truth: Henry was the leak (blackmailed after his intelligence source Ilyas was tied to Ahmed); Celia figured it out; at the dinner Henry poisons Celia's wine, but Celia had arranged with Vick — the restaurant manager Karl was listening; Celia dies; Henry is arrested.
